# Decentralized Compute Forum

> Independent data and analysis on GPU markets and decentralized compute

This site is static HTML in English. Chinese is available via the language toggle (client-side).

## Site pages

- [https://forum.omc.network/about](https://forum.omc.network/about): About — DCF
- [https://forum.omc.network/contact](https://forum.omc.network/contact): Contact — DCF
- [https://forum.omc.network/](https://forum.omc.network/): The Decentralized Compute Forum — GPU markets, DePIN & the price of AI
- [https://forum.omc.network/privacy](https://forum.omc.network/privacy): Privacy Policy — DCF
- [https://forum.omc.network/terms](https://forum.omc.network/terms): Terms of Use — DCF
- [https://forum.omc.network/tracker](https://forum.omc.network/tracker): Decentralized Compute Tracker — GPU networks compared, with sources — DCF
